data.title: Real-World Percent Applications
data.description: Practice calculating discounts, taxes, and tips by marking percentages on visual bars and finding the corresponding dollar amounts.

challenges.scenario: A bake sale raised $55. 80% of it goes to the animal shelter.
challenges.question: Step 1 — the whole bar is the $55. Mark 80% on the bar.

steps.prompt: Step 1 — the whole bar is the $55. Mark 80% on the bar.
steps.hint: 80% means 80 out of every 100. Slide the bar to 80%.

steps.prompt: Step 2 — How many dollars go to the shelter? Type the amount.
steps.hint: Find 10% first ($55 ÷ 10), then take 8 of those.

challenges.hint: 80% means 80 out of every 100. Slide the bar to 80%.

steps.hint: Find 25% first ($120 ÷ 4), then take three of them.

challenges.hint: 75% means 75 out of every 100. Slide the bar to 75%.
